name: David Jesue
source:
An Agent belonging to the 5/13.

A man of utmost loyalty to his mission; he grants no quarter to those who defy God.
The only thing stronger than his devotion to God is his devotion to combat—his physical abilities far surpass normalcy.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
